description: Relaxations this content type declares against the strict base processes. Every entry needs a reason: the file is the record of what was waived and why. Steps marked relaxable="false" in the BPMN cannot be listed here — the base is strict about those precisely so a package cannot opt out.

relaxations.reason: A document folio has no single domain lane the platform can name: the SME for a health-policy guidance note is a clinician, for a technical standard an engineer, for a report the programme owner. Relaxing the base step lets a folio bind its own reviewer in `authoring-a-document.bpmn` instead of routing every change through a lane that may not exist. The editor still sees the findings at Task_ReviewFindings, which is not relaxable and not waived.
relaxations.scope: All block kinds. A folio whose subject matter does have a standing SME should NOT rely on this relaxation — bind the reviewer and drop it.
